text.title: Purchase invoices in the books against what suppliers filed
text.lede: Each invoice is a card, sorted into a column by how the match came out. The column heading gives the count and the tax at stake, so the board reads as a to-do list: the tall columns and the old cards are where the work is.
text.boardSub: Input tax for March 2026, in USD. Select a card to compare both sides.

records.name: Tidewell Supply
records.reason: Same supplier, date and amounts. Only the invoice number is written differently.

attrs.action: Accept the match and record the supplier’s numbering.

records.name: Marlow Print
records.reason: One cent of tax rounding and a missing hyphen.

records.name: Yarrow Courier
records.reason: The supplier filed the invoice a day later than it is dated in the books.

records.name: Corvin Packaging
records.reason: The supplier filed tax at 10%. The invoice and the books show 20%.

attrs.action: Ask the supplier to amend the filing. 1,240.00 of credit is at risk.

records.name: Halden Foods
records.reason: Taxable value is transposed: 5,600 in the books, 6,500 in the filing.

attrs.action: Check the paper invoice, then correct whichever side is wrong.

records.name: Quillon Freight
records.reason: The supplier filed the invoice as exempt.

attrs.action: Ask the supplier to amend. 450.00 of credit is at risk.

records.name: Osei & Park
records.reason: In the books, absent from the supplier’s filing.

attrs.action: Chase the supplier. The credit cannot be claimed until they file.

records.name: Farrow Estates
records.reason: Rent invoice. The landlord has not filed for March.

records.name: Nadir Labs
records.reason: In the books, absent from the supplier’s filing.

attrs.action: Wait one more filing cycle before chasing.

records.name: Brightwater Dairy
records.reason: In the books, absent from the supplier’s filing.

attrs.action: Wait one more filing cycle before chasing.

records.name: Tidewell Supply
records.reason: Filed by the supplier, not in the books. The invoice may still be in the approval queue.

attrs.action: Find the invoice and book it to claim 552.00.

records.name: Sable Insurance
records.reason: Filed by the supplier, not in the books.

attrs.action: Confirm the service was received before booking.

records.name: Marlow Print
records.reason: The books hold this invoice twice, entered by two clerks. The supplier filed it once.

attrs.action: Reverse one entry. 420.00 of credit is over-claimed.
